title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, including its noise and outliers, which can negatively impact its performance on new data.

title: Role of Validation Set
text: The validation set is used to evaluate the model's performance during training. It helps in tuning the model's parameters to avoid overfitting.

title: Effect of Using Half the Validation Set
text: Consider how using only half of the validation set might affect the model's ability to generalize. Does it increase the risk of overfitting?
